issues.problem: Duplicate of いる (same verb, same reading, class and gloss); the kanji spelling is rare in modern writing.
Irregular imperative くれ (not くれろ), which the conjugation guide drills; the imperative form is irregular and outside the allowed set (する / 来る / 行く / ある / 良い).
Gloss 'wait' hides the transitive use (〜を待つ), although the entry is marked transitive.
